map.输入哈希空间位数与已存入的条目数量，工具用生日攻击模型估算发生碰撞的概率，提醒在: Enter hash-space bits and stored entry count; the tool uses the birthday-attack model to estimate collision probability, warning that risk rises sharply when n approaches √(2^bits).
map.去重/分桶设计：评估哈希桶规模接近平方根时冲突陡增的风险。: Dedup/bucketing design: assess the risk of collision spikes when hash bucket size approaches the square root.
map.唯一 ID 规划：为短 ID 选择足够位宽以控制业务内碰撞率。: Unique ID planning: choose enough bit width for short IDs to control in-business collision rate.
map.安全边界：说明短哈希用于标识而非防碰撞的极限。: Safety boundary: note that short hashes are for identification, not collision resistance, and their limit.
map.：约 5 万条时碰撞概率已近 1%，接近 √(2^32)≈6.5 万后快速上升，: : At about 50,000 entries collision probability is already near 1%; after approaching √(2^32) ≈ 65,000 it rises fast, need to upgrade to 64 bits.
map.生日悖论下碰撞概率在条目数约 √(2·2^bits) 量级开始显著，而非 2^b: Under the birthday paradox, collision probability becomes significant at about √(2·2^bits) entries, not 2^bits.
map.业务去重应级联二次校验（如原值比对），不能只信哈希相等。: For business deduplication, cascade a secondary check (e.g., raw value comparison); do not rely only on hash equality.
map.抗意外碰撞 64 位通常足够；抗故意碰撞需 128 位以上加密哈希。: Against accidental collision, 64 bits is usually enough; against deliberate collision need 128+ bit cryptographic hash.
